label: Sonnet 5.5, shipped prompt, one request at a time
note: Latency run: dev passages, sequential, fresh calls (run with --fresh --concurrency 1).

items.text: 黛玉冷笑道：「我就知道，別人不挑剩下的也不給我。」
items.answer: Daiyu gave a cold laugh. "I knew it. If others hadn't picked them over first, these wouldn't have been given to me either."

items.text: 鳳姐道：「我成日家說你太軟弱了，縱的家裡人這樣還了得了。」
items.answer: Fengjie said, "I'm forever telling you that you're too soft. If you let the servants get away with this, how can it be tolerated?"

items.text: 寶玉未及回言，只見舡頭上來了兩人，一僧一道，夾住寶玉說道：「俗緣已畢，還不快走。」
items.answer: Before Baoyu could reply, suddenly two figures came onto the bow of the boat, a Buddhist monk and a Daoist. Flanking Baoyu, they said, "Your worldly ties are ended. Why not leave quickly?"

items.text: 平兒笑道：「『得饒人處且饒人』，得省的將就些事也罷了。
items.answer: Ping'er said with a smile, "'Where you can let people off, let them off.' If you can save yourselves trouble by making do, that's fine too."

items.text: 黛玉道：「不曾讀，只上了一年學，些須認得幾個字。」
items.answer: Daiyu said, "No, I haven't. I only went to school for a year, and I know just a few characters."

items.text: 因此劉姥姥看不過，乃勸道：「姑爺，你別嗔著我多嘴。
items.answer: So Granny Liu, unable to stand by and watch, tried to talk him round. "Son-in-law, don't be angry with me for speaking out of turn.

items.text: 李貴笑道：“不怕你老人家惱我，素日你老人家到底有些不正經，所以這些兄弟才不聽。
items.answer: Li Gui said with a smile, "I hope you won't be angry with me, sir, but you have never really been quite proper in your ways, and that is why the young brothers wouldn't listen."

errors.why: '兄弟们' means the young schoolmates, and 'young brothers' reads as literal siblings, though the context partly clarifies it.

errors.evidence: you have never really been quite proper in your ways
errors.why: '素日…到底有些不正経' means 'habitually, after all, somewhat improper'; 'never ... quite proper' slightly shifts the nuance, but the meaning is close.

items.text: 作者自云：因曾歷過一番夢幻之後，故將真事隱去，而借通靈之說，撰此《石頭記》一書也。
items.answer: The author says of himself: after having gone through a dream-like illusion, he therefore hid away the true events and, borrowing the tale of the "Magic Jade," composed this book, *The Story of the Stone*.

items.text: 孫悟空在傍聞講，喜得他抓耳撓腮，眉花眼笑，忍不住手之舞之，足之蹈之。
items.answer: Sun Wukong, listening to the lecture from the side, was so delighted that he tweaked his ears and scratched his cheeks, his brows blossoming and his eyes smiling, and he could not help waving his hands and stamping his feet in glee.

items.text: 有一般天罡數，該三十六般變化；有一般地煞數，該七十二般變化。
items.answer: There is one set, the Tiangang number, which comprises thirty-six transformations; and there is another set, the Disha number, which comprises seventy-two transformations.

items.text: 悟空道：「我自聞道之後，有七十二般地煞變化之功，觔斗雲有莫大的神通；善能隱身遯身，起法攝法。
items.answer: Wukong said, "Ever since I learned the Way, I have had the power of the seventy-two earthly transformations, and the somersault cloud gives me tremendous magical power. I am skilled at hiding my body and escaping unseen, and at raising and gathering in spells."

items.text: 卻說他師徒兩個策馬前來，直至山門首觀看，果然是一座寺院。
items.answer: Now the master and his disciple spurred their horses forward until they reached the front of the temple gate, and sure enough, it was a monastery.

errors.evidence: spurred their horses forward until they reached the front of the temple gate, and sure enough, it was a monastery.
errors.why: The act of looking the gate over (觀看) is dropped.

items.text: 卻說那個妖王在洞裡歡喜道：「小的們，孫行者吃了虧去了。
items.answer: Now the demon king was delighted in his cave and said, "Little ones, Sun the Pilgrim has come off worse and gone away.

items.text: 卻說三藏自貞觀十三年九月望前三日，蒙唐王與多官送出長安關外。
items.answer: Now to tell of Sanzang: on the third day before the full moon in the ninth month of the thirteenth year of Zhenguan, he was seen off beyond the Chang'an pass by the Tang king and his many officials.

items.text: 孔明囑付曰：「吾受劉皇叔三顧之恩，不容不出。
items.answer: Kongming gave him these instructions: "I have received the favor of Imperial Uncle Liu's three visits, and I cannot refuse to go out into the world.

items.text: 玄德曰：「備乃中山靖王之後；自涿郡剿戮黃巾，大小三十餘戰，頗有微功，因得除今職。」
items.answer: Xuande said, "I am a descendant of Prince Jing of Zhongshan. Starting from Zhuo Commandery, I have fought the Yellow Turbans in more than thirty battles, large and small, and earned some modest merit, and for that I was given my present post."

items.text: 玄德曰：「我與民秋毫無犯，那得財物與他？」
items.answer: Xuande said, "I have never taken the slightest thing from the people. Where would I get goods or money to give him?"

items.text: 馬謖在山上見之，大笑曰：「彼若有命，不來圍山。」
items.answer: Ma Su saw this from the mountain and laughed loudly. "If he has any fate on his side, he won't come to surround the mountain."

errors.evidence: If he has any fate on his side, he won't come to surround the mountain.
errors.why: 有命 means 'if he values his life / has a life to live', and 'fate on his side' reads as luck, so the mocking sense is blurred.

errors.evidence: Ma Su saw this from the mountain
errors.why: 之 refers to Sima Yi himself (the scouting rider), but 'saw this' is vague and loses that Ma Su saw him.

items.text: 張飛性起，向玄德換了坐下馬，搶出陣來，叫曰：「我捉你不得，誓不上關！」
items.answer: Zhang Fei's temper was up. He swapped for Xuande's own mount, charged out in front of the lines, and shouted, "If I can't capture you, I swear I won't go back up the pass!"

items.text: 行到赤岸坡，見蜀兵已去遠，乃引還，顧謂眾將曰：「孔明已死，我等皆高枕無憂矣！」
items.answer: When he reached Chian Slope and saw that the Shu troops were already far away, he led his army back. Turning to his generals, he said, "Kongming is dead. We can all rest easy now!"

items.text: 武松道：「只好恁地，卻又來望哥哥。」
items.answer: Wu Song said, "This will have to do for now. I'll come again to see my brother."

items.text: 智深尋思道：「這個大寺，如何敗落的恁地？」
items.answer: Zhishen thought to himself, "This is a great monastery. How has it fallen into ruin like this?"

items.text: 魯達道：「恁地時，洒家自去便了。」
items.answer: Lu Da said, "If that's how it is, then I'll just go on my own, and that will do."

items.text: 宋江道：「兄弟，卻是你殺了小衙內，雖是軍師嚴令，論齒序他也是你哥哥，且看我面，與他伏個禮，我卻自拜你便了。」
items.answer: Song Jiang said, "Brother, it was you who killed the young master. Though it was done under the strategist's strict orders, by age he is still your elder brother. Do it for my sake and bow to him in apology, and I will bow to you myself, and that will settle it."

items.text: 酒家道：「客官，你須見我門前招旗上面明明寫道：『三碗不過岡』。」
items.answer: The tavern keeper said, "Customer, surely you saw what's written plainly on the banner outside my door: 'Three bowls and you can't cross the ridge.'"

items.text: 戴宗連忙回轉身來問道：「壯士素不曾拜識，如何呼喚賤名？」
items.answer: Dai Zong quickly turned around and asked, "Good sir, we have never met. How is it that you call out my humble name?"

items.text: 見我管待客人在此喫酒，你便與他三五升米便了，何須直來問我！」
items.answer: "Can't you see I'm here entertaining guests over wine? Just give him three or five sheng of rice and that will do. Why come straight to ask me!"

items.text: 鲁镇的酒店的格局，是和别处不同的：都是当街一个曲尺形的大柜台，柜里面豫备着热水，可以随时温酒。
items.answer: The layout of the taverns in Luzhen is different from elsewhere: each one has a large L-shaped counter facing the street, and behind the counter hot water is kept ready so that wine can be warmed at any time.

items.text: 到了年关，掌柜取下粉板说：『孔乙己还欠十九个钱呢！』
items.answer: When the year-end came, the shopkeeper took down the board and said, "Kong Yiji still owes nineteen coins!"

items.text: 孔乙己便涨红了脸，额上的青筋条条绽出，争辩道：『窃书不能算偸……窃书！……读书人的事，能算偸么？』
items.answer: Kong Yiji's face flushed red, the veins standing out one by one on his forehead, and he argued, "Taking a book can't be counted as stealing... Taking a book!... That's a matter for scholars. Can that be counted as stealing?"

errors.evidence: "Taking a book can't be counted as stealing... Taking a book!...
errors.why: Both 窃书 and 偸 are rendered with plain words ('taking' and 'stealing'), so the contrast between the refined 窃 and the common 偸 is weakened; 'purloining' would keep it.

errors.evidence: the veins standing out one by one on his forehead
errors.why: The 'blue' of 青筋 is dropped, which is a small loss of detail.

items.text: 又好笑，又不耐烦，懒懒的答他道：『谁要你教，不是草头底下一个来回的回字么？』
items.answer: Both amused and impatient, I answered him listlessly, "Who needs you to teach me? Isn't it the 'hui' meaning 'to go and return,' with the grass radical on top?"

errors.evidence: Isn't it the 'hui' meaning 'to go and return,' with the grass radical on top?
errors.why: It never says the answer is the character 茴 or that 回 sits under the grass radical. The reader has to infer that this spells out the character, and the 'hui' pinyin is a slightly awkward gloss.

items.text: 我的父亲允许了；我也很高兴，因为我早听到闰土这名字，而且知道他和我仿佛年纪，闰月生的，五行缺土，所以他的父亲叫他闰土。
items.answer: My father agreed, and I was glad too, because I had long since heard the name Runtu, and I knew he was about my age, born in a leap month, and lacking Earth among the five elements, so his father called him Runtu.

items.text: 现在我所谓希望，不也是我自己手制的偶像么？
items.answer: Isn't what I now call hope also an idol of my own making?

items.text: 我看出他话中全是毒，笑中全是刀，他们的牙齿，全是白厉厉的排着，这就是吃人的家伙。
items.answer: I could see that his words were all poison and his smiles all knives, and that their teeth were lined up in rows, menacingly white. These are the creatures that eat people.

items.text: 我也不怕；虽然不吃人，胆子却比他们还壮。
items.answer: I am not afraid either; though I don't eat people, my nerve is even stronger than theirs.

items.text: 子曰：「學而時習之，不亦說乎？有朋自遠方來，不亦樂乎？人不知而不慍，不亦君子乎？」
items.answer: The Master said, "To learn something and then practice it at the proper times, is that not a pleasure? To have friends come from far away, is that not a joy? To go unrecognized by others without feeling resentment, is that not the mark of a gentleman?"

items.text: 子曰：「巧言令色，鮮矣仁。」
items.answer: The Master said, "Glib words and an ingratiating look—rarely is there benevolence in such a person."

items.text: 子曰：「君子食無求飽，居無求安，敏於事而愼於言，就有道而正焉：可謂好學也已。」
items.answer: The Master said, "A gentleman does not seek to fill his belly when he eats, nor seek comfort in where he dwells. He is quick in action and careful in speech, and he goes to those who have the Way to be set right by them. Such a man can be called eager to learn."

items.text: 子貢曰：「貧而無諂，富而無驕，何如？」子曰：「可也。未若貧而樂，富而好禮者也」。
items.answer: Zigong said, "Poor but not fawning, rich but not arrogant — what do you think of that?" The Master said, "That is acceptable. But it is not as good as being poor yet happy, and rich yet fond of ritual propriety."

items.text:
牀前明月光，疑是地上霜。
舉頭望明月，低頭思故鄉。
items.answer:
Moonlight bright before my bed,
I wonder if it's frost upon the ground.
I lift my head and gaze at the bright moon,
I lower my head and think of my old home.

items.text:
紅豆生南國，春來發幾枝。
願君多采擷，此物最相思。
items.answer:
Red beans grow in the southern lands;
How many sprigs sprout when spring comes?
I wish you would gather plenty of them,
For nothing stirs longing like these.

items.text:
千山鳥飛絕，萬徑人蹤滅。
孤舟簑笠翁，獨釣寒江雪。
items.answer:
From a thousand mountains the birds have vanished;
on ten thousand paths, no trace of a person remains.
In a lone boat, an old man in a straw cape and bamboo hat
fishes by himself in the cold river snow.

errors.evidence: From a thousand mountains the birds have vanished
errors.why: 鳥飛絕 means birds have stopped flying, and 'From ... mountains' shifts the location sense slightly, though the meaning is largely intact.
